We are looking for a skilled Backend Developer. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, proactive, and eager to leverage AI to accelerate feature development through spec-driven approaches. You will work in an international agile team, collaborating closely with frontend developers, testers, DevOps, and business analysts.
 Discover Raiffeisen Tech 
 ✨Raiffeisen Tech Romania, a subsidiary of Raiffeisen Tech GmbH in Vienna, brings together experienced tech talents to enable Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) Group to offer innovative technology solutions. The company fosters a collaborative environment for building international projects using advanced technologies, embracing a flexible approach and valuing curiosity and courage to innovate.
 Your Mission 
Support and assist AI - powered Platform and Feature Teams in building and maintaining scalable
backend services and AI-driven tools
Utilize generative AI and machine learning tools to enhance productivity in coding, testing,
documentation, log analysis, and data validation
Contribute to seamless integrations across AI models, data services, and event-driven systems
Gain hands-on experience with cloud-native AI infrastructure, CI/CD workflows, and enterprise-grade AI
applications
Work with the latest GenAI platforms in Kubernetes, Azure, AWS & GCP.
 Required Superpowers 
Experience programming in Python or Java with familiarity or interest in GenAI, Large Language Models
(LLMs), coding agents, and agentic frameworks
Deep knowledge of software engineering principles and RESTful APIs
Enthusiasm for cloud-native AI platforms like Kubernetes and modern software ecosystems
Proven experience in GenAI based projects
Proficient in English
